title: Keep plans traceable from train to acceptance test criteria

facts.note: Planning artifact kinds of the coverage hierarchy; recognisable from the plan artifact type.
Any write to a planning artifact is in scope of the hierarchy invariant.

values: containment field changed (participants, features[], wmbts[], acceptances[])
facts.note: Diff-level observer over containment fields and acceptance test criteria; used to target checks, not to narrow scope — the invariant applies to the whole hierarchy.
Coverage validator findings per level; an observer must surface validator results to the planner.
Rollout phase decides whether validator findings are strict (blocking); an observer must expose the active rollout phase.

fires: Planner adds a wagon that no train lists among its participants
Planner adds a feature that no wagon lists in features[]
Planner adds a WMBT not listed in any feature's wmbts[] or with no acceptances[]
Planner adds an acceptance not referenced from a WMBT or without test criteria
Planner removes or rewrites the test criteria of an existing acceptance
Planner edits or deletes any train, wagon, feature, WMBT or acceptance
doesNotFire: Edits to production code or tests that do not touch planning artifacts (train, wagon, feature, WMBT, acceptance)

given: You are authoring or changing planning artifacts (trains, wagons, features, WMBTs, acceptances), including acceptance test criteria.
when: You create, edit, move or delete any artifact in the hierarchy, its containment links, or an acceptance's test criteria.
then: Keep the plan traceable along Train -> Wagon -> Feature -> WMBT -> Acceptance -> Test criteria, each level contained by its parent and guarded by its coverage validators; from Phase 2 (PLANNER_TESTER_ENFORCEMENT) those validators are strict, so their findings block the plan.
prefer: Register each wagon in a train's participants (COVERAGE-PLAN-2.1).
List each feature in its wagon's features[] (2.1, 2.2).
List each WMBT in its feature's wmbts[] (2.2, 2.3).
Link each WMBT's acceptances via acceptances[] and give each acceptance test criteria (2.3, 2.4).

Before handing off, run the coverage validators along the whole chain of every artifact you changed — its ancestors up to the train and its descendants down to test criteria, not only the level you edited.
Check the project's active rollout phase before deciding whether findings block; if you cannot establish it, report the phase as unknown rather than assuming findings are non-blocking.
avoid: Orphan artifacts that no parent level contains.
Fixing a validator finding by adding placeholder links or empty acceptances instead of real coverage.
why: Coverage only means something if every acceptance traces up to a train and down to test criteria; each level is guarded by validators so gaps surface during planning (ATDD Hierarchy Coverage Spec v0.1, section 2), strictly from Phase 2.
evidence: COVERAGE-PLAN-2.1..2.4 validators were run along the full chain of every new/changed artifact; in Phase 2 (PLANNER_TESTER_ENFORCEMENT) and later they pass strictly with no findings.
Reviewer can walk each new/changed artifact up to a train and down to acceptance test criteria.
verifier_detail: Level map (level -> {contains, validators}): Train contains Wagons via participants — COVERAGE-PLAN-2.1; Wagon contains Features via features[] — 2.1, 2.2; Feature contains WMBTs via wmbts[] — 2.2, 2.3; WMBT contains Acceptances via acceptances[] — 2.3, 2.4; Acceptance contains Test criteria — 2.4.
Validators become strict in Phase 2 (PLANNER_TESTER_ENFORCEMENT); the source does not specify validator behaviour before that phase beyond them not being strict.
This rule aggregates the per-level coverage validators (see related planner.coverage.* conventions).

splitSuggestion.then: Every wagon is contained in a train's participants (COVERAGE-PLAN-2.1).
Every feature is contained in its wagon's features[] (2.1, 2.2).
Every WMBT is contained in a feature's wmbts[] (2.2, 2.3).
Every WMBT links its acceptances via acceptances[] and each acceptance has test criteria (2.3, 2.4).

additions.text: The family bundles per-level containment obligations; each maps to a planner.coverage.* convention (see splitSuggestion). This rule keeps the end-to-end chain as its single obligation.
Fixing a validator finding by adding placeholder links or empty acceptances instead of real coverage.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-pattern required by authoring rules; implied by the traceability purpose but not literally in source.

additions.text: Before handing off, run the coverage validators along the whole chain of every artifact you changed — ancestors up to the train and descendants down to test criteria, not only the level you edited.
additions.justification: Makes 'each level guarded by coverage validators' actionable and prevents reading it as checking only the touched level, which would not prove the end-to-end trace the source requires.

additions.text: Check the project's active rollout phase before deciding whether findings block; if it cannot be established, report it as unknown rather than assuming non-blocking.
additions.justification: The source makes strictness phase-dependent (S009) but does not say how to tell the phase; this applies the general unknown ≠ exempt conduct so the planner does not silently treat findings as advisory. Adds no new requirement on pre-Phase-2 behaviour.

additions.text: Edits that do not touch planning artifacts do not fire.
additions.justification: Source gives no explicit scope boundary; this only restates that the rule concerns planning artifacts and does not exempt any planning-artifact edit.
